description: One dataset's overview: title, summary, topics, publisher, publication and update dates, canonical page URL, star and table counts, and every table with its id, title, license, immutable version_id, column count, column names and the capabilities the publisher enabled. Here and everywhere in this tool, publisher means the ACCOUNT that published the dataset — not the organisation the data was gathered from, which is a source's own publisher. Example: {"slug": "kden-metar-hourly"}. Column types, descriptions, units and published profiles are NOT here — call get_table_schema for one table when you need them. Use the returned table `id` (a UUID) with get_table_schema, sample_rows and query_table. Cite the dataset by canonical_url and the table by version_id.
name: get_dataset
title: Get a dataset
